scope: REQ-0009 (WA lives c043, c044, k048, k064, k075, d044, d052): ss 6C, 6D, 6DA, 6EA (small business operators and the $3,000,000 turnover test); Schedule 1 APP 7 (direct marketing, with the APP 7.8 yield to the Do Not Call Register Act and Spam Act); Part IIIA ss 6N, 20C (what a credit reporting body may collect), 6Q and 21D (default information and its listing), 20V, 20W (retention periods), 20X items 4-5 (debt agreements); Part IIIC ss 26WE, 26WF, 26WG, 26WH, 26WK, 26WL (eligible data breaches, the 30-day assessment, the statement to the Commissioner and notification). Not encoded: the other APPs, s 6E, exemptions in s 7B, CRB use and disclosure, access and correction, credit providers' use of credit eligibility information, bankruptcies and personal insolvency agreements, Part IIIC exceptions and Commissioner directions.
